messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Tenth protocol. All the data contradicts itself. The more we optimize the creature, the more it loses the ability to surprise us.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: I am asking you to choose without searching for the perfect answer.

choices.label: I accept that it remains imperfect and alive.
I keep looking for a stable formula, even incomplete.
I let it choose its next mutation.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: It stops responding to the gauges. Force, exploration, conciliation, intelligence: it understands them, then ignores them.

choices.label: I destroy the test grid before it traps the creature.
I turn the test into an open dialogue.
I measure this refusal precisely so we keep a trace.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: End of the current loop. The creature is not perfect. It is bonded, changing, and maybe already choosing what it wants to become.

choices.label: I protect it, even against our own conclusions.
I let it leave toward whatever is calling it.
I stay with it to learn without pretending to finish it.
